name: Seomara Cube Fest 2026
information: Se vais competir pela primeira vez, certifica-te que lês todas as informações em [Informação Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeomaraCubeFest2026#68784-informacao-importante-important-information), *[ Perguntas Frequentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeomaraCubeFest2026#68785-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* e no [Regulamento WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Se és associado da APS tens direito a um **desconto exclusivo de 20%**, sabe mais [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeomaraCubeFest2026#68788-associados-aps-aps-associates). • If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeomaraCubeFest2026#68784-informacao-importante-important-information), the *[FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeomaraCubeFest2026#68785-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* and the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you're an APS associate you can take advantage of an **exclusive 20% discount**, find out more [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeomaraCubeFest2026#68788-associados-aps-aps-associates). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTUwMTAyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4dd776bed8475b9fb8af048c3f15cd95c7b3f9ab/SeomaraCubeFest2025.png) Segue-nos no nosso [Instagram!](https://www.instagram.com/seomaracubefest/) | Follow our [Instagram!](https://www.instagram.com/seomaracubefest/) **Espetadores podem assistir gratuitamente! | Spectators may attend for free!**
